llm.summary: This is a text-only policy brief drafting skill with clear source, disclosure, and review safeguards.

dimensions.detail: The skill handles potentially sensitive policy and coalition material, but it explicitly tells the agent to honor disclosure posture and exclude confidential material from tool calls, examples, and external searches.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown documentation only; no executable scripts, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, or tool-wrapping behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are bounded by phased intake, required audience/ask/date confirmation, source discipline, counter-evidence handling, draft labeling, and limits against legal advice, fabricated citations, partisan attacks, or certainty about outcomes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, credential use, privilege escalation, local indexing, or cross-session memory modification is present in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's capabilities match its stated purpose: converting user-provided policy research into a draft decision-maker brief with options analysis, source mapping, risks, and talking points.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, users should understand that this skill may process sensitive policy, advocacy, and coalition materials in-session. Use appropriate review by a policy lead or counsel, and avoid providing confidential material unless the agent environment is approved for it.
